scope: Both maps consume the physics optimizer's existing JIT execution cache, never a separately requested hypothetical zero-thrust/zero-aero future. Shared orbital readouts and native thread-worker reuse.

contract.source: FlightAuthority::jit_coast_execution_end borrows the same coast eligibility, bounded interval and geometry/medium/constant-spin certificate helpers as execution. It also checks current cache validity and endpoint solver bounds. Maps do not request bakes, integrate trajectories, advance simulation time or mutate execution state.
contract.interval: Only the currently certified coast-batch interval is drawn, bounded by the scheduler, cache horizon and existing maximum batch duration. The map endpoint uses the same cache interpolant as physics, even between stored nodes; no synthetic impact marker is attached to the guard boundary.
contract.unsupported: Powered/live/state-dependent/controlled/contact/stale-cache states without this executable batch certificate produce no curve. This is intentionally not a claim that generalized powered JIT futures exist. PlanExecutionMode::Baked does not itself contain precomputed state samples.
contract.worker: The existing server ThreadBakeQueue moved into flight-authority with a compatibility server reexport. It uses the existing run_bake, one job at most, reset-discard without oversubscription and shutdown join. Native local physics installs it; remote replicas never install/request it.
contract.readouts: Shared dominant-body Ap/Pe/escape are instantaneous two-body diagnostics, not full-field trajectory predictions or solved contact. Local scheduler countdowns and transmitted wake_notice remain distinct; remote maps suppress the local countdown and retain observed notices. Solver reference and gravity do not change.

verification.status: Immediate user-requested push after all mandatory CI-equivalent gates passed; extended native release ignored suite still running at push time. No all-fourteen-gates claim.
verification.source_boundary: Previous full source manifest plus the new shared thread_bake.rs; retains the server-wrapper source path. Final documentation/evidence edits are outside this compiled-input set; no assets or dependencies changed.
regressions: 50-second alarm-bounded interval query followed by real physics execution ends at exactly the cache position and velocity queried for the map; powered, stale and guidance-dependent states are refused
Counted queue proves opening/reading/pausing/resetting the map never requests a hypothetical bake or steps paused physics
Real native free-coast worker fixture compares projected samples and endpoint with the authority cache, checks unchanged paused state/time/step counters and withdraws the curve on powered demand
Projection budget <=1025 points, exact supplied guard endpoint without an interior stored node, per-node ephemeris epochs, no gap bridging or fabricated impact marker
Circular-orbit readout apsis error <0.02 m at 500 km altitude about Thessa and Nereid; display hint does not change solver reference; escape/suborbital/degenerate labels retain wake suffixes
Remote map own-epoch regression suppresses local future/countdown and keeps the transmitted observed wake notice
Moved worker test checks harvest, drops a second busy request and discards reset results without detaching a stale worker
verification.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics / RADV STRIX1 / Vulkan / Mesa 26.2.4-arch1.1

limitations: Generalized powered/live execution-future production and publication remain unimplemented (doc 07 section 7.10); no alternate coast is drawn in their place
Conservatively omits controlled tick-coasts that do not pass the shared batch certificate; does not draw the unchecked remainder of a long cache
Existing sampled geometry certificates and numerical coast tolerances are retained, not upgraded into a continuous-interval proof; changing inputs/plans may invalidate a displayed future
No remote executable-trajectory or future-scheduler payload, no maneuver editor and no new simulation law
No OS-level input injection, independent whole-frame visual/usability acceptance, Metal/WebGPU execution, remote CI or game-FPS improvement claim
Bevy retirement remains incomplete; retained instruments, flight/event fixtures, optical/render consumers and packaging/tooling still need replacement
